d:
Ganga nadi men jama gad (silt) ke prabandhan ko lekar kendr sarkar aur bihar sarkar ke bich hue samjhaute (MoU) par janta dal yunaited (JDU) ke rashtriy karyakari adhyaksh va rajyasbha sansad sanjay jha ne apni pahli pratikriya di hai. unhonne is karar ko bihar ke lie ek "aitihasik vikas" karar diya.
Sanjay jha ne bataya ki nadiyon men gad jama hona ek ganbhir samasya rahi hai, jisse nadiyon ki jaldharan kshamta (Carrying Capacity) lagatar ghatti ja rahi thi. is samjhaute ke tahat ab nadiyon se silt nikali jaegi, jiska istemal bihar bhar men sarkon ke nirman ke lie mitti ke rup men kiya jaega.
